prs.title: Gracefully terminate active sessions during StreamableHTTP shutdown
prs.author: Bortlesboat
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled on shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI incomplete-response errors. prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled on shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI incomplete-response errors.
